name: makersuite-api-version-status
purpose: D-H2, STATUS URL: `gemini.apiVersion: v1` must also drive the MAKERSUITE /api/backends/chat-completions/status arm, so the provider receives GET `/v1/models?key=<key>&pageSize=1000` rather than `/v1beta/...` (chat-completions.js:1911 reads the same `getConfigValue('gemini.apiVersion','v1beta')`, :1912-1914 builds the models URL, google-models.js:36-38 appends pageSize). DISCRIMINATING BECAUSE: the version is IN THE RECORDED REQUEST TARGET and the target is compared exactly (only the recorder origin is normalized); an implementation that hardcodes the default -- the pre-fix Go behaviour, which also hardcoded the same version for the status URL -- records `/v1beta/models?...` and fails with the version as the only difference. It is a SEPARATE scenario from the generate one on purpose: the two pinned paths are distinct call sites (:730 vs :1912) and a fix that threaded the version into only one of them would pass one and fail the other. The unit-level gate is TestGoogleChatAPIVersionFollowsTheConfig/status.
